newsitem.title: USA: Crown American Realty says sees turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Crown American Realty says sees turnaround.

text.p: Crown American Realty Trust said Wednesday it expects a significant turnaround in performance beginning in the second half of 1997 and continuing into 1998.
The company said the strategy of to transform its specialty store retail tenant base is working, and momentum in tenant sales and small shop leasing is accelerating.

The company said that in the first quarter, comparable small shop sales increased by 6.6 percent and small shop leasing activity increased 25 percent in amount of space and 16 percent in higher rental rates.
The company said it expects funds from operations to begin improving in the second half of the year.
The company also said its new lease with Regal Cinemas of Knoxville, Tenn. will contribute to revenues and FFO in late 1997 with full year impact beginning in 1998.
The company reported a loss per share for the quarter of $0.05 compared to a profit of $0.07 for the same period a year ago.
